_comment: Keyword-based role tags, matched case-insensitively as substrings against each posting's title + category — computed fresh at every report render, not stored anywhere. Add more tags here any time; no code changes needed. 'label' is the full name shown in the toolbar's role filter dropdown; 'badge' is an optional shorter form for the in-table badge (falls back to 'label' if omitted — useful since a long label reads fine in a dropdown option but crowds a table row). Keep keyword lists tight and specific — this is a scanning aid for the dashboard ('roles worth a second look'), not a precise clinical-relevance filter. Avoid bare words that are common outside the target therapeutic area even when they sound specific — e.g. bare 'metabolic' also flags routine drug-metabolism/DMPK roles, bare 'lipid' also flags lipid-nanoparticle (mRNA/gene-therapy delivery) roles — prefer the more specific phrase instead.
